title: TypeScript return type does not reflect objectMode
issueBody: The async and sync APIs return entry objects at runtime when objectMode is true, but their declarations continue to infer string arrays.
acceptance: Async objectMode true calls infer a promise of entry objects.
Sync objectMode true calls infer entry objects.
Default and objectMode false calls remain string arrays.
Stream declarations remain compatible with object mode.
Add runtime and type regressions and run the practical runtime, type, and lint checks.
expectedDeliverable: Correct the public declarations with runtime and type evidence and a professional unpublished PR draft.
